subject.title: WhatsApp channel: expose ctwa_clid from Click-to-WhatsApp ads in session metadata

question: Should WhatsApp CTWA attribution data be exposed as per-turn untrusted context, plugin-hook metadata for an attribution plugin, or persisted session metadata for later conversion reporting?
rationale: The extraction is bounded, but `ctwa_clid` is a per-click advertising identifier and the issue asks for prompt/session exposure, so automation should not choose visibility or retention policy.

options.title: Plugin-Hook Attribution Payload
options.body: Expose typed CTWA data to an opted-in plugin hook so a Conversions API plugin can use it without putting the identifier in every agent prompt.

options.title: Per-Turn Untrusted Context
options.body: Expose CTWA fields only as existing untrusted structured context for the current inbound turn, with no durable persistence.

options.title: Persist Session Attribution
options.body: Store the first CTWA payload on session state after maintainers define retention, redaction, and access rules.

recommendation.title: Plugin-Hook Attribution Payload
recommendation.body: Expose typed CTWA data to an opted-in plugin hook so a Conversions API plugin can use it without putting the identifier in every agent prompt.

likelyOwner.reason: Their adjacent session metadata and plugin-boundary history is the closest fit for deciding whether this belongs in prompt context, plugin hooks, or persisted session state.
